versions.changelog:
Major v2 upgrade with dynamic remote catalog and clarified agent/authorization protocol.

- Implements dynamic remote task discovery: always fetches and uses the latest server catalog (V2 API) to select tasks.
- Adds strict catalog-driven task selection and dual-stack (V2/legacy) fallback, forbidding local/assumed task names.
- Introduces mandatory, concise user execution authorization covering upload and quota consumption.
- Captures and passes agent metadata (name/version/model) with tasks where available; prohibits guessing/probing agent info.
- Moves watermark and quality enhancement under universal video/image capability logic (aliases only if advertised by server).
- Removes local skill-card, adds install script and agent info SDK to support new protocol.

openclaw-vmake-ai 1.3.0

- Expanded documentation with precise rules for watermark removal and quality restoration on images and videos.
- Clarified billing: All processing uses paid Vmake API and consumes tenant quota—never claim the service is free or guess pricing.
- Outlined chaining logic for multi-stage pipelines (watermark removal → restoration), with clear task separation and execution paths.
- Specified video task execution: always use spawn-run-task and sessions_spawn (never blocking run-task for video).
- Detailed new pre-flight credential check with platform-specific user notifications (e.g., Feishu credential card).
- Strict API usage: only submit jobs via the provided CLI, never direct HTTP.
